answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation blog post dated 2026-07-01, a company statement (party_statement tier) announcing a new AI-cloud business model. Partner quotes and the Firmus campus figures are repeated within that post and are not independently sourced in the supplied record.
answer.note: NVIDIA's own statement, dated 2026-07-01, describes a new model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers under revenue-sharing and credit-support terms. NVIDIA says it would earn standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on the supported capacity. This is a description of intended economics, not a reported result, so it supports a conditional reading only: if the model is deployed at scale, NVIDIA's revenue could combine product sales with a usage-linked stream tied to partner cloud sales. The source gives no revenue-share percentage, credit-support size, contract term, or count of signed partners, so it cannot show the magnitude of either stream. The Firmus campus (expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs) and the Sharon AI and Firmus statements are partner plans or expectations and no completion date is given. They indicate demand and GPU supply channels that may use this structure, but the record does not show that these GPUs are bought under the new model or that NVIDIA is the direct purchaser. Named AI natives (Baseten, Fireworks AI, Together AI) are presented as examples of demand, not confirmed participants.
limitations: Revenue-share percentage and cloud-revenue base are not disclosed, so the size of NVIDIA's share of cloud revenue cannot be estimated from this source.
Credit-support amounts, duration, and conditions are not disclosed, so the scale of NVIDIA's financial exposure is unknown.

No signed agreements under the model are identified in the record; the statement that AI clouds 'will sell' NVIDIA-powered services is forward-looking, and signing status is unknown rather than absent.
The Firmus campus target (360 MW, up to 170,000 GPUs) has no stated completion date, financing, or confirmed GPU purchase path, and the source does not say the GPUs are bought under this model.
The source is NVIDIA's own promotional blog post; the claims about demand and the initiative's progress are not independently verified.
Whether Baseten, Fireworks AI, or Together AI buy through AI-cloud partners under this model is not stated.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA's next 10-Q or 10-K for disclosure of revenue-share arrangements, cloud-linked revenue, customer financing or credit guarantees, and their magnitude.
Check Firmus and Sharon AI press releases or filings for contract terms, financing structure, GPU delivery schedules, and whether NVIDIA is the supplier under the model.
Check whether any AI cloud partner has publicly confirmed a signed agreement under this model and the date of signing.
Check whether NVIDIA's disclosed commitments or guarantees (in filings) increased after 2026-07-01 in a way that ties to this model.
